verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers domain registration, DNS, transfers, webhooks, SDKs, and WHOIS privacy, but contains no documentation of data retention policies, account/data deletion controls, or export/erasure mechanisms for user or customer data. WHOIS privacy (enable-whois-privacy) addresses public exposure of registrant data, not retention/deletion of account data held by name.com. Missing for 10: no data retention policy, no account/data deletion API or process, no GDPR-style export/erasure mechanism, no documentation addressing how long user data is kept or how to purge it.
